front.title: TTTPS Deep-space Profile: Propagation-Aware Time Attestation

abstract.t: This document defines an experimental deep-space companion profile for the TLS TimeToken Secure Protocol (TTTPS). It preserves the fixed Proof-of-Time core record and separates cryptographic validity from propagation-aware temporal applicability. The profile binds physical context out of band, distinguishes one-way light time from two-way transaction delay, defines evidence and disposition boundaries, and composes peer aggregation with optional confidence qualification. It does not claim flight performance, a live interplanetary mesh, or replacement of existing navigation or delay- tolerant networking standards.
